issues.title: Mid/far rows still snowy: the snow is in near-LOD rows (<9.5 m), so the far-LOD flat fabrics miss it
issues.evidence: q15 far boxes: L130.7 / B/R 1.33 vs 115.3 / 1.48 and p90/p10 3.50 vs 5.88, against w35 131.4 / 1.32 / 3.62. z_far3: rows 3-8 show white tick snow and lighter backs, with no dark row gaps. The camera is at z 48.05 and LOD near is 9.5 m, so nearly every visible row is near LOD.
issues.fix: Either (a) fade the photo tile contrast with distance for the econ fabrics: in the shader, mix the tile toward its mean by smoothstep(4.0, 8.0, viewDist), as a per-material flag set on ECON_PAN* / yFabric*. Or (b) cheaper: in econSeat when lod===1 (mid LOD), or in buildSeats for econ rows more than 4 m from the camera, use econFarMat() so that rows 4+ take the flat mean colours. Then re-measure the y150-200 box (target L~115, B/R ~1.48).

issues.title: Life-vest pouch now an opaque brown bowl rather than a smoky grey shield
issues.evidence: c_e10_under: core #2b201d, rim #5a5560, and nothing shows through. y_47302 (p302crop): the shield is translucent grey #43444d, the vest inside is a darker grey with a small tan/yellow glint, and the rail and leg are visible through it.
issues.fix: Outer gCyl: c '#5d6068', r 0.1, with a glass/alpha material if the Builder supports one (otherwise keep it opaque but cool grey). Inner core: c '#33343a' (cool, not brown), radius 0.07. Add a small 0.03x0.01 '#8a7350' box on the core face for the glint.

issues.title: Dash mosaic and tick pans now too blue under the new lighting; tick pans still flat
issues.fix: ECON_PAN_C photoBase('#444c72') -> '#464d68' (same L, less blue). For ECON_PAN, desaturate the base ~6 % toward grey and raise the y_tick tile gain (LAYER_PARAMS, shared, one line) so the ground drops while the ticks stay light.

issues.title: Pillows plain plaques; fleck specks haloed; belt V still on every pan (carried)
issues.evidence: z_low against y_47300: puffed bow-tie pillows with pointed corners, and no visible belts. c_e11: haloed specks.
issues.fix: Pillow: loft the outline with the corners pulled out 1.5 cm, the edge midpoints pinched 1 cm and a 5 mm centre dent. Fleck: clamp the dark end of the y_fleck swatch. Belts: if the user picks tucked, drop the straps and keep only the buckle stubs at the crease (z -0.24, y 0.47).

issues.title: Headrest cover slightly light; hard black tray lip under the pan fronts
issues.evidence: Cover L54 vs 37-45 in y_47300 (the pan Ls are now within ~6, so the lighting no longer explains all of it). c_e11: a crisp black tray edge under every pan front, where y_47302 shows a soft cavity.
issues.fix: SEATMAT.yCover c darker by ~12 % (shared, one line). Tray: gRBox depth 0.41 -> 0.39, centred 2 cm further back, r 0.6 -> 0.8.
